prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet, sixteen actual consecutive frames in a 4-column by 4-row grid, transparent PNG.
Primary request: Animate the existing Moss Circuit Spore Reactor performing a ROOT-UNFURLING SUMMON ATTEMPT, visibly different from its current radial projectile burst. Use the reference only for exact character identity and art style.
Input image 1: identity/style reference. Preserve the floating circular brass-and-moss mechanical ring, luminous mint-green central orb, purple side vent nozzles, asymmetric brass armor segments, and trailing moss roots. Three-quarter view facing LEFT throughout, same proportions and scale. No feet, hands, or new body parts.
Style/medium: same detailed crisp chunky pixel-art-inspired game sprites as reference. Green moss, weathered brass, turquoise orb, subdued purple vents. Strong silhouette, no broad blurry glow.
Scene/backdrop: genuine full transparency with NO environment, no ground plane, no cast floor shadows, no checkerboard, no black or white backdrop.
Layout: exactly 16 independent full sprites, four rows and four columns, generous transparent gutters, equal cells, every part entirely within its cell. Keep central green orb at an identical within-cell position throughout. Do not make the body progressively larger. One character per cell. No labels, text, numbers or watermark.
Row-major sequence:
0-6 preparation: ordinary closed hover, moss roots beneath the ring slowly spread LEFT and RIGHT into a forked root cradle beneath the body, lower armor plates rotate open slightly, central orb gradually intensifies. The root silhouette becomes increasingly spread, not a radial explosion. Purple side vents stay calm.
7 release: forked roots reach their widest low spread, a single small downward-facing mint seed-light held within the roots. It is an attempt cue only, not an actual creature or projectile.
8-15 recovery: little seed-light extinguishes quickly, moss roots progressively retract and lower plates close, central orb settles back to the original quiet hover. Final frame matches original idle appearance. Continuous clear pose development, no repeated exact poses.
Constraints: NO child enemies, eggs dropped on the ground, beams, airborne projectiles, radial bullets, starburst spikes, explosion halo or screen-space summoning circle. Nothing should imply a guaranteed successful spawn. No death, broken pieces, black soot, or hurt flash. Keep the robot's identity intact. Prefer visible root movement over color-only changes. Preserve enough margin for safe sprite extraction.
